common_conditions: 3GPP TS 23.280 V19.10.1, Release 19; other versions are not implied
Stage 2 information flows and procedures; not a wire-format implementation
condition_rule: Every claim inherits all common_conditions and adds its own conditions; do not extract a claim without both.

conditions: A subscribed MC service user cancels its subscription
claims.conclusion: Stop delivery to that subscriber; do not infer cancellation for all recipients.

conditions: Location report
claims.conclusion: Measurement time accompanies location information; accuracy is optional and at least one listed location element is supplied.

conditions: Single MC system
Group-targeted reporting trigger
LMS has already subscribed to group dynamic data from the MC service server
The requesting LMC is subscribed and authorized for the target location information
Current affiliation is determined from the latest server notification
claims.conclusion: Track current affiliation and cancel the relevant group trigger when a user de-affiliates.

conditions: Event-triggered location notification
Single MC system
Recipient is subscribed and authorized to receive the target location information
claims.conclusion: Notification is not proof of a newly performed measurement.

conditions: Applicable non-null UE-label configuration
Message direction matters
For the notification procedure in 10.9.3.6.1, single MC system operation
claims.conclusion: Do not include the UE label in location notification to the MC service server.

conditions: Primary MC system, single-domain high-level example
Actual signalling UA SIP-core registration, or independently evidenced optional third-party registration with the MC service server(s)
claims.conclusion: Classify the actual SIP-core transaction and, when present, the separate optional MC service server leg. Neither establishes LMC enrolment at LMS, provision/reception of location reporting configuration, or a fixed time to send it.
evidence_notes: Figure 10.6.1-1; step 3 and note about distinct service authorization. This claim classifies the discussed events, not normative SIP status codes.

conditions: Single MC system
Initial provision or subsequent update of event-triggered location reporting configuration to the relevant LMC(s)
claims.conclusion: In the message branch LMS sends the configuration to the applicable LMC(s), via individual unicast or multi-LMC MBMS group message as listed. A separate location reporting configuration message is unnecessary when the applicable user profile provides that configuration. Unknown profile contents do not establish the exemption or an immediate push obligation.
evidence_notes: Figure 10.9.3.1-1 step 1 and NOTES 2–3. The absence of an applicable profile is not a stage-3 trigger, deadline or inference that an implementation failed.

conditions: Single MC system
Relevant LMC's applicable reporting rule actually names the event
The configured event actually occurs on this LMC; it may be initial registration or actual receipt of location reporting configuration
claims.conclusion: Steps 2–3 prompt an LMC report of LMS-identified, LMC-available information; this is not the LMS step-1 push. The clause does not map initial registration to a named IMS, LMS enrolment or MC service authorization transaction. Do not substitute LMS send for LMC receipt in the configuration receipt case, or infer that the particular report was received or contains a new measurement.
evidence_notes: Page 207 trigger examples; figure 10.9.3.1-1 and steps 2–4 page 208. An actual report or LMS receipt is separate evidence.

conditions: Identified CSC-14 reference point between LMC and LMS; this definition specifies receiving the LMC-originated location information report at LMS
claims.conclusion: CSC-14 uses HTTP-1 (client–proxy) and HTTP-2 (proxy–server) reference points. These are names, not HTTP wire-version choices or proof of actual application role, delivery or LMS enrolment from arbitrary HTTPS. Do not use this reference point to eliminate the distinct step-1 MBMS bearer alternative.
evidence_notes: Architecture reference point only. Related bearer comparison in 10.9.3.1 p208; it does not establish a wire API mapping.

conditions: Identified CSC-15 reference point between LMS and MC service server; classify actual message function
claims.conclusion: Group dynamic data subscription/notification signalling uses SIP-2. Other CSC-15 signalling, including the stated location request/receive role, uses HTTP-1 and HTTP-2 reference points. Do not widen the SIP-2 exception to functional alias status or treat group data subscription as proof of a location subscription, enrollment, configuration or distribution success.
evidence_notes: The clause mentions retrieval of affiliation and functional alias status; the named SIP-2 exception is explicitly only group dynamic data subscription/notification.

verification.scope: 既有五项声明沿用上列既有核验。新增 SIP 注册、事件配置及 CSC‑14/15 五项按各声明自身 verification 读；不继承旧独立使用验证。
